desc:
Please 👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVORITE to support us!

🧁 Welcome to Greenz Bakery Cafe V3! A cozy roleplay bakery where you can work, serve customers, and have fun.

💵 Earn tips while you work
🍰 Serve up tasty orders behind the counter
🔼 Earn points and climb the staff ranks
🏁 Take on a fun obby
🔥 Build a daily login streak
🧽 Clean tables and spills on the job
🏆 Collect tons of cool badges
💚 Make friends while baking together

💼 Looking for a job? Apply at the bakery by clicking the suitcase button on your screen!
